title: Point-in-time recovery
statement: The system shall restore a cluster to any chosen timestamp within a 7-day retention window, losing no more than 5 minutes of committed transactions.
rationale: Quorum replication protects against node loss, not operator error or corruption.

acceptance_criteria.text: After destroying the cluster, restoring to a chosen timestamp recovers all transactions committed at least 5 minutes before the loss.
Restore throughput is measured and published per node, and the documented RTO formula predicts measured restore time within 20%.
